subject: Success plan draft and proposed 30-day pilot timeline
messages:
From: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@stellarlabs.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Success plan draft and proposed 30-day pilot timeline

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers and routing controls look promising. Our product and infra teams want a concrete "who does what when" so we can get sign-off from procurement.

Can you share a simple success-plan template (we call it an "action slate") your team uses to lock milestones, technical gates, and procurement steps? Ideally a Google Doc + a 2-slide summary we can drop into our internal kickoff.

Target: we'd like to start a 30-day pilot the week of July 13 if possible. Key questions we need to align on:
- Data residency & SOC 2 artifacts (our security team)
- Pilot scope (sample endpoints, traffic profile)
- Cost estimate and any reserved capacity options for predictable throughput

If you can send a draft I can populate our stakeholder roster and return with internal comments by Friday.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Senior PM, Stellar Labs

Subject: Re: Success plan draft and proposed 30-day pilot timeline

Alex —

Nice to meet you over email. Attaching a compact action slate and a 2-slide summary that we typically use to accelerate pilot approvals. The doc has clear lanes (Stakeholders, Tech readiness, Procurement, Success metrics) and a recommended 30-day cadence.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_edit (Success_Plan_Template_v1.gdoc)
Slides: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Slide_example (30d_Pilot_Slate_v1.gslides)

Quick notes on the timeline you proposed (week of July 13):
- Week 0: access provisioning + baseline tests (you + infra)
- Week 1: integration + small-batch traffic (validate correctness)
- Week 2: throughput tuning (batched paths, KV/prefix caching)
- Week 3: validation against acceptance prompts + cost check
- Week 4: retrospective + decision (go/no-go or extension)

Monica — I’ve looped you for the security gating and suggested evidence stub (attached). Ben — please add high-level cost checkpoints and any reserved-capacity notes.

Next steps for Alex: drop your stakeholder names into the doc and flag any procurement deadlines; we’ll update the milestones and send a cleaned PDF for your procurement team.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Success_Plan_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc), 30d_Pilot_Slate_v1.gslides (Google Slides)]

Subject: Re: Success plan draft and proposed 30-day pilot timeline

Dylan / Alex —

Reviewed the template. A couple of small security/controls suggestions before we send to Stellar's procurement:
1) Add a "Minimum Evidence" checklist for SOC 2 + network controls (I attached a one-page stub that lists the typical artifacts we can provide quickly).
2) Make the data-flow diagram explicit in Week 0 (who has access to tokens/logs) and include retention defaults.
3) Add a clear rollback/fallback policy for the pilot (e.g., automatic fallback to smaller-model variant if latency spikes).

I attached the stub: security_evidence_stub.pdf — it's not exhaustive but helps speed reviews. Alex, if your security team wants a deeper packet, we can route an engineer for a 30-min review call.

Monica
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: security_evidence_stub.pdf]

Team — a few additions on the commercial checkpoints to include in the slate so procurement sees the full picture:
- Cost checkpoint (end of Week 2): estimate vs actual tokens and projected monthly run-rate.
- Reserved capacity option: we can offer a 3-month trial of Dedicated with a discounted commit (we should present both: hosted per-token vs dedicated commit).
- Paperwork: provide a short checklist for procurement (NDA complete, SOW draft, invoice contact).

I added a small pricing table in the doc (approx numbers) and a suggested procurement timeline that fits Alex's July start. Ben

Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — this is exactly what we needed. I populated the stakeholder section with our leads (Kate M. from Security, Priya K. in Procurement, and Marco L. from Platform). I also added our target acceptance prompts in the "Success metrics" lane.

A few quick confirmations:
- Security: Kate will review the security_evidence_stub.pdf and requests a 30-min call; available Tue 7/14 10am PT.
- Procurement: Priya needs the SOW + estimated invoice contact by 7/9 to hit our internal approval for a 7/13 start.
- Commercial: we prefer to see both hosted and dedicated cost lines; Ben, can you turn the pricing table into a one-pager for Priya?

If we can lock the SOW and procurement paperwork by 7/9, we should be set to kick off access provisioning the week of 7/13. I'll coordinate internal calendar invites after the call confirmation.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Alex
